title: Differentiation
summary: f'(x) = lim h→0 [f(x + h) − f(x)]/h. It is the slope of the tangent and the rate of change of f.
d/dx(xⁿ) = nxⁿ⁻¹; d/dx(c) = 0. Sum: (u ± v)' = u' ± v'. Product: (uv)' = u'v + uv'. Quotient: (u/v)' = (u'v − uv')/v². Chain rule: dy/dx = (dy/du)(du/dx), e.g. d/dx(1 − x²)⁵ = 5(1 − x²)⁴(−2x).
Implicit functions: differentiate both sides treating y as a function of x, then collect dy/dx.
Parametric form: dy/dx = (dy/dt)/(dx/dt). For x = at², y = 2at: dy/dx = 2a/(2at) = 1/t.
Second derivative: d²y/dx² = d/dx(dy/dx). For parametric curves, d²y/dx² = [d/dt(dy/dx)]/(dx/dt) — for x = at², y = 2at it is −1/(2at³), not t.
Derivative of one function with respect to another: d(u)/d(v) = (du/dx)/(dv/dx).

vsa: Find the derivative of x² from first principles.

f(x + h) − f(x) = (x + h)² − x² = 2xh + h².
[2xh + h²]/h = 2x + h → 2x as h → 0.

3x² + 3y² dy/dx = 3a(y + x dy/dx).
dy/dx(y² − ax) = ay − x² ⇒ dy/dx = (ay − x²)/(y² − ax).
sa: Find the derivative of tan x from first principles.

f'(x) = lim h→0 [tan(x + h) − tan x]/h = lim [sin(x + h)cos x − cos(x + h)sin x]/[h cos(x + h) cos x]
= lim sin h/[h cos(x + h) cos x] = 1 × 1/cos²x = sec²x.
